title: Control Inference and Adaptation
core_invariant: Inference converts frozen-checkpoint logits into selected tokens. Greedy decoding is argmax and is invariant to temperature for T > 0. Temperature and top-k/top-p rescale or truncate the distribution; they are not quality knobs. Seed replay is a sampling claim tested with other settings fixed. Stop and max-tokens change termination, not the checkpoint. Prompt/context changes the prefix. Inference configuration is reproducibility evidence. Adaptation hierarchy is prompt, retrieval, tools, then parameters; fine-tuning is the wrong first response to a freshness problem. Predict before every inference action. Search, RAG, and tool execution stay closed. Generic WP-137 table, metric, and trace blocks carry the evidence; there is no custom frontend.

stages.title: Frame token selection and the adaptation rubric
stages.instructions: Restate the M31 stage-aware checkpoint (inference_ready, training_time=False). M32 ends P5/V07: checkpoint → prompt → logits → temperature → top-k/top-p → greedy or seeded sample → stop/max-tokens → tokens plus InferenceConfig. Vocab alpha-beta-gamma-stop, seed 3201. Identify gate evidence: a WP-137 table of softmax at two temperatures, a metric of greedy index, and a config fingerprint. Do not implement search, RAG, or tools. The generic workbench renders catalogue blocks; do not expect a named decoder page.

stages.title: Predict, decode, and table temperature versus greedy
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the local logits table. (1) PREDICT greedy argmax on [1, 3, 2, 0], that T>0 leaves greedy unchanged, that (log 3, 0) at T=1 softmaxes to (0.75, 0.25), and that the same seed replays. (2) COMMIT the prediction. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the teaching decoder; emit WP-137 blocks: a table of temperatures versus entropy, a metric of greedy_index and seed replay, and a trace of filter order temperature-then-top_k-then-top_p-then-softmax. (4) OBSERVE the structured table. (5) SUBMIT an explanation of any delta. Change stop or prompt with sampling fixed. Route freshness to retrieval, not fine-tuning first. Do not treat temperature as a quality knob.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; the submitted explanation covers the observed table and why later-mission mechanisms stayed closed.

stages.title: Read prompt, scores, filters, sample/greedy, stop, metadata
stages.instructions: Read prompt selecting local scores, filter order, fail-closed live adapter, config fingerprint (checkpoint, prompt, temperature, seed, stop, max-tokens). Predict greedy/temperature independence and required log fields. Do not inspect an M33 index. Submit an annotated system-flow artifact.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: The trace names the teaching dataflow and does not open later-mission internals.

stages.title: Diagnose uncontrolled settings or the wrong adaptation lever
stages.instructions: One named fault: two sampled runs share checkpoint and prompt but not temperature and seed, so a naive compare labels the disagreement model_changed; or a team proposes parameter change because holiday hours are stale. Predict which InferenceConfig fields must match before blaming the model, and that freshness is a retrieval route. Execute, emit a WP-137 table of first_divergence or wrong_route, and repair from the broken object. Decoder and checkpoint stay fixed. Submit prediction, discriminator, smallest repair, and regression.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each failure names one controlled cause; the repair restores the named contract.

stages.title: Control inference without assistance
stages.instructions: From a blank page, compute greedy and the (log 3, 0) softmax, call an uncontrolled record, choose an adaptation route for freshness, and list required metadata. Tutor surfaces stay locked. Emit a WP-137 metric of independent arithmetic. Leave learner answers unfilled in the repository.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Independent no-AI reasoning names the teaching contract and a valid repair.

stages.title: Author the V07 adaptation hierarchy and inference-config ADR
stages.instructions: Author the V07 ADR: prompt → retrieval → tools → parameters, required logs, revisit triggers, alternatives, owner, status, and date. Do not implement search, RAG, or tools here.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR names a teaching-scale decision, alternatives, and a revisit trigger.

stages.title: Close V07 with an inference provider contract
stages.instructions: Connect accepted decoding to V07 and hand M33/M34/M37 an InferenceConfig provider contract plus an adaptation decision hierarchy. Do not hand them a retriever, RAG pack, or tool executor. Phase P5 ends here.

stages.title: Evaluate inference and adaptation evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, temperature-table experiment, uncontrolled-settings failure, unassisted transfer, and ADR against the gate contract. Issue PASSED or targeted repair. Do not award completion from a quality-knob story.
